answers.answer: They first leaned towards a spongy rubber case (stress-ball-type material) and ended with a plain solid plastic case. The switch was a cost cut: a plastic case let them keep the LCD within budget. (Medium confidence on the 'first leaned' part.)

brief:
BRIEF FOR TEAM TS3012 BEFORE THE FINAL MEETING (d). Built from meetings a, b and c only.

1. WHAT HAS BEEN DECIDED
- Money: production price about 12.5 Euro, selling price 25 Euro. [TS3012a: "The production price, twelve and a half Euros, approximately."]
- Audience: young buyers (under forty), not older people. [TS3012b: "Everything we target is under forty, so."] [TS3012c: "Our focus is the young audience. So let's stick to that."]
- Energy: regular batteries. [TS3012c: "energy, we choose regular regular batteries"]
- Chip: advanced, because the LCD screen needs it. [TS3012c: "it has to be an advanced one now"]
- Case material: rubber, colourable (yellow suggested to look flashy and young); wood and titanium are out. [TS3012c: "the material will be rubber, suppose"] [TS3012c: "You can make rubber in any colour."] [TS3012c: "I would take a yellow remote control. To have it flashy, to have it it's for young people."] [TS3012c: "No, wood i wood's not an option."] [TS3012c: "we're not d we're not using titanium"]
- Headline features: LCD screen and speech recognition, argued to be the features that add new functionality. [TS3012c: "whereas speech recognition and L_C_D_ screen do offer new functionality in your product"]
- Scroll-wheel: voted out as having no real added value. [TS3012c: "you could use it for the channels and for the volume"] [TS3012c: "I don't see anything missing really"]

2. WHAT CHANGED ALONG THE WAY
- Speech recognition: meeting b called it very hard across many countries and leaned to the LCD; by meeting c both were in the design. [TS3012b: "I think implementing speech recognition is such a small um apparatus, it's very hard to do."] [TS3012b: "I think it's L_C_D_ is better now."] [TS3012c: "whereas speech recognition and L_C_D_ screen do offer new functionality in your product"]
- Price pressure: in b the LCD put the 25 Euro selling price in doubt. [TS3012b: "Oh, we're not going to be able to sell it for twenty-five then, with an L_C_D_ screen."]
- Energy: kinetic was the industrial designer's favourite but was rejected (a remote lies still almost all the time), which also ruled out the rechargeable unit. [TS3012c: "My personal uh fav favourite is the kinetic provision"] [TS3012c: "remotes lie still I think like ninety nine percent of the time"] [TS3012c: "this rules out our unit our rechargeable unit"]
- Scroll-wheel: first called cheap if it does not push, then voted out. [TS3012c: "if we take a normal scroll-wheel without the pushing, then it's not expensive"] [TS3012c: "I don't see anything missing really"]

3. OPEN ACTIONS (owner)
- Research LCD versus speech recognition: cost and space. Asked by Speaker A (project manager); Speaker C answered 'I'll try to'. Owner not clearly assigned, so confirm. [TS3012b: "Just to do research into both, w what it costs and what it takes for space."]
- Everyone to think of a product name (proposed by Speaker C; Speaker B agreed). [TS3012b: "let's give this uh a name, and not like some vague serial number"] [TS3012b: "So I think of a name"]
- Design sketch for next meeting, requested by Speaker A (addressee not clear in the transcript, likely the UI designer). [TS3012c: "You doodle a doodle us a nice nice design for for the next meeting"]
- Costing: no finance information was available to the team. [TS3012c: "I'm not sure if we're if we're gonna get finance anyway"]

4. DISAGREEMENTS STILL OPEN
- Curves: one curve was judged fine for cost, but Speaker C also wanted the whole case curved and B said curved is more trendy. Single versus double curve is not settled. [TS3012c: "I think one curve is uh fine."] [TS3012c: "I would curve the whole actually"] [TS3012c: "It can be curved, because that yeah, it's a little bit more trendy to be curved."]
- Scroll-wheel: Speaker C accepted the vote only as a design flourish and argued it can be flashy without function. [TS3012c: "It's not because it's functional, but it's just to add to the design, to have it flashy."]
- Removable cover: raised by Speaker D, but Speaker A said it is not part of the basic design; may be revisited. [TS3012c: "that's not something we're working with in the basic design"]
- LCD versus speech recognition on cost and space is still to be researched (see actions). [TS3012b: "we could put a microphone in here for example"]
